guidance: Integrate security into every CI/CD stage. Key practices: build base AMIs periodically with EC2 Image Builder and Amazon Inspector; run SAST and DAST as mandatory pipeline stages; scan for secrets and open-source vulnerabilities; block production promotion on high/critical findings. For unfixable third-party vulnerabilities, deploy custom WAF rules as a temporary compensating control. AWS CodePipeline can orchestrate all stages.
how_to_check: Are SAST and DAST scans mandatory pipeline stages? Are production deployments blocked on critical findings? Are secrets and dependencies scanned in the pipeline? Are base AMIs rebuilt periodically with Inspector scans? For more information, please refer to the documentation.
